candidate.title: CATCH-IT
candidate.scope: The CATCH-IT (Covalent Attachment of Tags to Capture Histones and Identify Turnover) middle row of the assigned Illumina poster crop, from cells and AHA labeling to extracted histone-associated genomic DNA. The left nucleosome cartoon and acronym expansion summarize the assay; they are not an extra preparation or material branch. Inventory: methionine-starved cell, AHA-treated cell, isolated blue nucleus, cycloaddition caption, biotin-marked chromatin with MNase caption, fading/removal and streptavidin-bound histone–DNA icons, DNA-extraction arrow, and final two-line DNA icon. This is one retained path, with reagents entering local transformations and no depicted split, pooling, or alternative CATCH-IT route. Separate THS-seq above and MINCE-seq below are neighboring poster entries, not alternatives identified by this CATCH-IT card. Primary Deal et al. content clarifies metabolic protein labeling, mostly mononucleosomal digestion and H3/H4-selective retention. Scope ends at DNA; no adapter-ready sequencing library, instrument or computational workflow is depicted.

The primary Drosophila implementation and a mouse application support this assay architecture without establishing identical full protocols across specimens.
